name: Petaluma Gap
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: An AVA in southern Sonoma and northern Marin counties, running from the Pacific Ocean to San Pablo Bay and lying mostly inside the Sonoma Coast AVA. Its low, rolling terrain lets cool marine wind and fog flow inland, strongest in the afternoon. The wind gives smaller, thicker-skinned grapes that need longer on the vine.
